what_happened: B3a de-risked by a compiled probe: Decidable (NfEvalNf) on finite decidable structures by induction on depth; kTypeOfFin agrees with the classical kTypeOf on the standard axiom profile. The predecessor's 'kTypeOf is Classical.dec by design' is an implementation choice, not an obstruction.

inferInstanceAs on Z-subtype orders/equality resolves through Int.instConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder, which is noncomputable; every decidability instance for segZ must be an explicit term (Int.decEq/Int.decLt via decidable_of_iff, Fintype.subtype on Finset.Ico) or the device silently becomes noncomputable.

Plan authored directly from the research report: B2 split into B2a (this record) and B2b (successor) on the structural ground that the fibre is a product (seamOmegaEquiv); the research's dischargeSet closure key was dropped because LocalRun is a consequence of Presented (clTrace_localRun), not a run condition of the presentation, which simplifies B3b to a k-type-keyed reachability closure.

Phase 1 (B3a) landed in two builds: the compiled research probe transcribed into KTypeFin.lean with explicit instance binders; the only defect was the decidable_of_iff argument order (target first), fixed on the second build. #eval witnesses and axiom profile matched the probe exactly.

Phase 2 generic bridge plusStab_iff_forall_hitSig compiled on the first build with the SeamMulti proof transcribed verbatim (only stabTarget_seamTrace swapped for stabTargetSig_of_trace); the three build errors were peripheral (Sum.noConfusion form, set_option-before-docstring, Atom namespace).
Phase 3 Trace.lean built green on the first guarded build: every LocalRun/Anchored field closed by Iff.rfl as the plan predicted; only a long-line style warning.

lean_multi_attempt whole-file diagnostics reported an empty list while the scoped lake build of Compose.lean still had 3 errors (a getElem-application parse issue, an omega missing the segment bound, and List.length_append taking implicit args); the build log, not the LSP sweep, is the authority for phase closure

Phase 5 uniqueness proof (eq_clTrace_of_localRun_anchored, 7-case structural induction) compiled green on the first scoped build with no tactic iteration: every temporal case closed by rw [run clause] + simp only [IH] + Iff.rfl exactly as the plan's Risks row 1 predicted; 84 lines vs 150-250 hypothesis.

Phase 6 merged module measured 932 lines (>900 trigger): split the presentation half into RaySummary/Present.lean per the plan's own Scope Hypothesis rule; Present.lean added to file scope via the plan's Files to modify.

Phase 6: one generic bounded-measure stabilization lemma (iterate_stabilizes) serves both the path-type closure (increasing key image) and liveness (decreasing prune), replacing the planned pigeonhole+cycle-unrolling; the whole draft elaborated clean on the 4th single-file check and the depth-1 #eval witnesses run in ~7s.

Instance resolution cannot synthesize DecidablePred for a conjunction under a binder (fun x => b = true ∧ x ∉ S) although fun _ => instDecidableAnd typechecks; worked around by naming the predicate (Extendable) with its own instance. Also Fintype.card (KType sig k) enumerates 2^256 functions at depth 1, so the closure bound had to be arithmetic (closureBound_eq).
